Remark
[Necessity of the nonspherical hypothesis] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0138 1. ch19:19.57\group $\kappa $-Gap

The hypothesis cannot be removed: spherical space forms $S^3/\Gamma $ have unbounded orders $|\Gamma |$, and $S^3/\Gamma \times \mathbb R$ gives the corresponding four-dimensional obstruction.
